contract: Complete matmul/bias/scale/ReLU/balanced sum with fresh intermediates, task scheduling, scalar readback and cleanup. Resident excludes initial three uploads. Activations keeps B resident and uploads A/bias per call; transfers uploads all three per call. Loading/compilation excluded. Same driver/task archive/shader bundle; only Metal runtime archive differs. Exact dyadic checksums in all warmup/calibration/timed rounds. No CPU affinity/frequency/desktop isolation. Dynamic budget max(64MiB,16*(M*K+K*N+M*N)+4096). Profiling is separate from acceptance.
